{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[A Crown of Swords]]'' by the same name, see ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 21|Swovan Night]]''. For other uses of the word "night," see [[Night]].}}
'''Swovan Night''' is a [[:Category:Holidays|holiday]] falling on [[Taisham 13]].<ref>''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]''</ref> Nothing really is known about the holiday save that pine boughs are used to decorate windows and peoples' hair and there is dancing and music.

==Noted celebration==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] was in [[Ebou Dar]] for Swovan Night in {{ne|1000}}. Queen [[Tylin]] cajols Mat into spending the night with [[Beslan]].{{ref/book|7|16}} When Mat visited [[The Wandering Woman]], he noticed that the windows had been decorated with pine boughs.{{ref/book|7|17}} During Swovan Night, Mat was attacked by [[Darkfriend]]s and discovers [[Birgitte Silverbow]]'s true identity.{{ref/book|7|21}}
